$orderId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['createdAt','status','customer','items','total']) && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('total').isNumber() && newData.child('status').val() in ['recebido','preparando','saiu para entrega','entregue']

$date..validate: newData.hasChildren(['date','salesTotal','manualInputs','adjustments','closingTotal','expectedCash','difference','orderCount','operator','finalized']) && newData.child('date').isString() && newData.child('salesTotal').isNumber() && newData.child('closingTotal').isNumber() && newData.child('expectedCash').isNumber() && newData.child('difference').isNumber() && newData.child('orderCount').isNumber() && newData.child('finalized').isBoolean()
